clues.text: Reaching a top speed of 50 mph and an 82-foot height, this thrill ride turns passengers upside down 5 times.
This steel coaster was manufactured by Mack Rides and welcomed its first riders in 2019.
Riders can find this attraction in the state of North Carolina, located in the city of Charlotte.
Right out of the station and before its first launch, the train slowly rolls through an inversion commonly known as a jojo roll.
The name of this coaster evokes the sudden, venomous bite of a reddish-brown pit viper.

evidence.quote: Copperhead Strike is a double launched roller coaster at Carowinds in Charlotte, North Carolina.
The ride starts with a slow heartline roll out of the station (an element sometimes referred to as a jojo roll) before a right hand turn into Granny Byrd's shed.
